title: Valencia and Real Betis Face Off in LaLiga
seoTitle: Valencia and Real Betis Face Off in LaLiga
subtitle: The Primera División clash takes center stage as the only match scheduled for this Tuesday.
excerpt: Valencia and Real Betis face off at Mestalla this Tuesday, August 25, in the only Primera División match of the round.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
The football match between Valencia and Real Betis takes center stage this Tuesday, August 25, 2026, as the only Primera División fixture scheduled on the official calendar for this matchday. The clash will take place at the Mestalla stadium starting at 19:00.

Kick-off time and match details

The match between Valencia and Real Betis is the only LaLiga EA Sports fixture scheduled for this Tuesday, August 25. The official LaLiga website sets the kick-off at 19:00 at the Mestalla stadium, where Valencia will play as the home team. There are no other Primera División matches scheduled for this matchday on the official calendar.

How Valencia approaches the match

Valencia approaches the match at Mestalla after a 0-0 draw against Celta in the previous round. The end of that match against Celta sparked growing criticism from the stands targeting manager Carlos Corberán and the players. For this fixture, the team welcomes back Luis Rioja after recovering from a muscle injury, while Justin de Haas, Copete, Foulquier, and Alberto Marí remain sidelined.

The situation at Real Betis

Real Betis enters the match full of confidence after securing a 1-0 victory in their league opener against Real Sociedad. Manuel Pellegrini's squad features the inclusion of striker Troy Parrott. The manager is still unable to count on Diego Conde, Ruibal, Lo Celso, Abde, Morante, and Petit due to physical issues, while awaiting movements in the transfer market.

The dynamic at Mestalla

Real Betis looks to extend its strong run in visits to Mestalla, where they have secured four wins and one draw in their last six visits. Meanwhile, the Valencian side will try to claim their first victory of the season in front of their home fans following their opening draw.

With information from MARCA, El Pespunte, COPE.
